answer: Resist sybil floods by making influence age-gated, not headcount-gated. Every identity must lock a published minimum bond in a time-locked haven for N epochs before its votes or attestations count; publish N and the bond so peers can audit them on-chain. Early withdrawal burns one-third and resets the aging clock. Until the lock matures, the account stays on a ledge of observability only: the deposit is visible, but cannot tilt settlement or recruit. Hollow aliases therefore arrive with zero weight, and the wait-plus-burn makes throwaway copies costlier than attested work under one identity.
